title: 第526章 得知一切真相第525章 谁
lines: “傻大个就是……”
话到这，界灵突然想起很久远的记忆，当时傻大个可是管小心的爷爷叫老爹……
另外，自己新主人不正是当年在无极界里出生的婴儿吗？
等等，老头该不会没告诉她这些事吧？
不会她什么都不知道吧？
界灵心里咯噔一下，感觉要糟。
小心看出它的犹豫，所以直接强硬道：“身为你的主人，我命令你将所有的事都说出来。”
无形力量已经束缚住界灵的思维，它瞬间老实道：“是。”
它一挥手，一幅画面再次悬空播放。
画面里，一张憨厚的面容浮现。
他好似在看摄像头一般，好像在跟小心对视。
看着这张面孔，小心愣住了，心脏没来由的一紧。
“这是谁。”她死死盯着那张脸。
界灵道：“一个意外进入这里的人，是和他妻子一起进来的，他们在这里生活了很长一段时间。
他就是在这里获得了悟道树，然后应该是出去之后再交给主人的爷爷，最后又到了主人手里。
他称呼主人的爷爷为老爹。”
“老爹？”小心眼眸不知不觉间就湿润了，她想起幼年时期无数个夜晚询问云溪阿姨自己父亲和母亲在哪里。
现在，她好像看见答案了。
画面还在播放，里面的憨厚男人已经从一块藤蔓上拿下一颗种子，然后毫不犹豫吞了下去。
见状，小心问道：“界灵，他把种子吞了之后会怎么样。”
界灵面露难色道：“会……唉……”
它挥手加速画面，很快加速到很久之后。
虎子身体变得透明，最终呈现出身体里的全部景象。
一棵小树寄居在其丹田之中，根茎在其体内密密麻麻到处都是。
见此情景，小心一下就哭出了声，接着就是放声大哭。
在外面她是站在世界顶峰的界主境大能，可是直到此刻她才知道自己父亲是怎么死的。
怪不得，怪不得爷爷从来没有说过。
如果她更早得知这个消息，她一定会将悟道树给毁掉。
凭什么，凭什么一株树就害得自己从未见过父亲。
“唉。”界灵轻叹一声，随后继续切换画面。
事到如今，也只好全盘托出了。
画面再次变换，这次出现了两个人。
另一个穿着一身红袍，长发及腰。
画面不断闪烁，最终在一片绝地里，女人突然倒下了，然后虎子从她肚子里抛出一个婴儿。
界灵道：“那是一片混乱的时间领域，是当年那场大战造成，他们不小心误入其中，而她本来就寿命不多。”
扫了一眼那个婴儿，小心恍惚间上前几步，然后直勾勾盯着倒下的女人，不自觉伸手过去想要触碰她。。
姜芸，虎子的妻子，小心的母亲，小霜的后代。
手穿过投影，小心回过神来，问出一个已经确定的答案：“我是这个婴儿，他们是我的父亲母亲对吧。”
界灵叹息着点头道：“没错主人，你这个时候其实也一不小心被影响了，所以已经成为将死之人。
你的父亲正是为了突破后获得功德之力救活你，所以才不得已吞下悟道树种子。
content_en:
"The stupid guy is just..."
At this point, Jie Ling suddenly remembered a long time ago memory. At that time, the stupid but careless grandpa called him daddy...
In addition, isn’t his new master the baby who was born in the Wuji Realm that year?
Wait, did the old man not tell her these things?
Doesn't she know nothing?
Jie Ling's heart skipped a beat, feeling worse.
Carefully noticed its hesitation, so he said forcefully: "As your master, I order you to tell everything."
The invisible force has bound the world spirit's thinking, and it instantly said honestly: "Yes."
It waved its hand, and a picture hung in the air and played again.
In the picture, a simple and honest face appeared.
He seemed to be looking at the camera, as if he was looking at Xiao Xin.
Looking at this face, I was stunned and my heart tightened for no reason.
"Who is this?" She stared at that face.
Jie Ling said: "A person who accidentally entered here came with his wife, and they lived here for a long time.
It was here that he obtained the Enlightenment Tree, and then it was supposed to be handed over to the master's grandfather after going out, and finally it was in the hands of the master again.
He calls his master's grandfather daddy. "
"Dad?" Xiao Xiao's eyes became moist without realizing it. She recalled the countless nights when she was a child asking Aunt Yunxi where her father and mother were.
Now, she seemed to see the answer.
The video was still playing, and the honest man inside had already taken a seed from a vine and swallowed it without hesitation.
Seeing this, he asked cautiously: "World Spirit, what will happen after he swallows the seeds."
The world spirit looked troubled and said: "Yes...sigh..."
It waved its hand to speed up the scene, quickly speeding up to much later.
Huzi's body becomes transparent, finally showing the entire scene inside the body.
A small tree lives in his Dantian, with roots and stems densely packed everywhere in his body.
Seeing this scene, I burst into tears for a moment, and then burst into tears.
Outside, she is a powerful person in the realm of world lord who stands at the top of the world, but she didn't know how her father died until now.
No wonder, no wonder grandpa never said it.
If she had known the news earlier, she would have destroyed the Enlightenment Tree.
Why, why did a tree prevent me from ever seeing my father?
"Alas." World Spirit sighed softly, and then continued to switch screens.
Now, I have no choice but to tell everything.
The scene changed again, this time two people appeared.
The other was wearing a red robe and had long hair reaching his waist.
The picture continued to flicker, and finally in a desperate situation, the woman suddenly fell down, and then Huzi threw a baby from her belly.
World Spirit said: "It was a chaotic time realm, caused by the war that year. They accidentally entered it by mistake, and she didn't have long life."
He glanced at the baby, took a few steps forward cautiously, and then stared straight at the fallen woman, unconsciously reaching out to touch her. .
Jiang Yun, Huzi's wife, careful mother, Xiaoshuang's descendant.
He passed his hand through the projection, carefully came back to his senses, and asked a definite answer: "I am this baby, and they are my father and mother, right."
World Spirit sighed and nodded: "Yes, Master, you were actually accidentally affected at this time, so you have become a dying person.
Your father had no choice but to swallow the seeds of the Enlightenment Tree in order to obtain the power of merit to save you after the breakthrough.
title_en: Chapter 526: Knowing all the truth Chapter 525: Who
